title: finding(types): 126 published refusal strings and 139 docblocks say a content channel on a reads-neither node drew "no error, no warning, no element", but the parser tier's not-a-container warning fired
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a defect with named sites, class (b): published text that states something false. **`reach:` public door, measured.** The strings are the `.describe()` text and the issue messages that `safeValidateSchema` / `objectui validate` hand to an author or an AI. Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #1 (`session_01DuWo5bdP9SdVebamn99GGk`) from the contract reviews of PR objectui#10907 (`5865466392`, `5865826151`) on objectui#9256. ⛔ Not graded here.

## What is false

The family-D / E3 content-channel tombstones explain why a channel is refused with the sentence 「an authored value therefore rendered NOTHING — no error, no warning, no element」 (the wording varies slightly). On `origin/main`:
- **126** occurrences in `packages/types/src/zod`: 63 tombstone pairs across 12 files, all published refusal and `.describe()` strings.
- **1** more, split across two lines, in the shared `neitherContentChannelGuidance` builder (`zod/tombstone.zod.ts`). So the 13 helper-fed arms publish it at runtime too.
- **139** in the matching TS docblocks under `packages/types/src` (for example 27 in `form.ts` and 20 in `data-display.ts`).

The render path is right: no render-time error or warning, and no element. But the sentence says no warning at all, and that is false.
- `packages/sdui-parser/src/validate.ts` `validateTree` (objectui#9910) emits a `not-a-container` warning for any node carrying `children` whose registration declares no `children` input.
- A reads-neither registration declares no `children` input by construction.
- Measured in PR objectui#10907 by the dev and twice by its reviewer: all 12 E3 keys plus `input` / `ui:input` warn with `children` and stay silent without; a `div` control stays silent.

PR objectui#10907 corrected this sentence in the three pending changesets that carried it. The published strings and docblocks were out of that PR's scope: changing them is a published-message change, not a prose edit.

## Fix (direction, for triage)

- One mechanical sweep: the helper sentence, the 126 literals and the 139 docblocks take the wording PR objectui#10907 settled on: 「no render-time error or warning and no element; only the parser tier's `not-a-container` warning (objectui#9910) noticed it」 (in the past or present tense, as each string's context needs).
- A `patch` changeset for `@object-ui/types` (published messages).
- No pin asserts the substring: the pins read `NEITHER content channel`, `What it renders instead:` and describe-equals-message. So a rewording moves no assertion. Keep it that way, or add one pin on the helper.
- Serial: `packages/types/src/zod/**` and the TS declarations are shared with every family-D / types slice. Map open PRs at claim time.

## Dedupe

The 1000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs were grepped locally for `no error, no warning, no element`, `not-a-container` near tombstone / refusal / describe, and `neitherContentChannelGuidance`. The hits:
- PRs objectui#10907 and #10897, the source of this finding.
- objectui#10417 (closed): a different sweep of the same strings, fixing the tense of their `BaseSchema` premise, not this sentence.

Dedupe words: `no error, no warning, no element` · `not-a-container` · `neitherContentChannelGuidance` · `content-channel tombstone message` · `family D refusal string`
